title: Aye Saniye Zehra
body:
Aye binte Ali sabera aye gham zada duhkiya aye saniye zehra, ghar ghar meinhai matam tera aye Zainab-e-kubra aye saniye zehra
Do laashe jo juhin oun-o-mahamad ke uthaye shabbir ne laye, bibi wo tera sabr ka aur shukr ka sajda aye saniye zehra
Be gor-o-kafan dhoop mein tha bhai ka laasha sar tan se juda tha, hamrah tha naize pa sar-e-sayede wala aye saniye zehra
Laasha kabhi ham shakle payambar kauthaya laila kosambhala, khud sabr kiya tune diya sab ko dilasa aye saniye zehra
<<DIVIDER>>
Zalim ne kiya sar pa tere belche ka war shabbir ki gham khar, ab teri shahadat ka hai gham daher mein barpa aye saniye zehra
Kaisa ye sitam tujh pa hua gham zada bibi sar hogaya zakhmi, ab dashte bala mein hue zainul aba tanha aye saniye zehra
Hain ashko ka nazrana liye sab tere gham khar sab tere azadar, tu de de dua inko toh ehsaan tera hoga aye saniye zehra
Rakhta hai tadap dil mein rasheed ab yehi bibi hai arzoo, farma de karam karle khubool uska ye nouha aye saniye zehra..
